EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
  MINUTES
  MARCH 25, 2019

A regular meeting of the Equestrian Committee of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called
to order by CHAIRMAN HUFF at 7:05 p.m.

Committee Members Present:  Huff, Brtis, Ciarolla, Kemp, Silvano, Shinn

Committee Members Absent:  Dean-Porter, Harik, Zigrang.

City Staff Present: Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Community Services Coordinator Daniel A-Haja
  Administrative Analyst Jessica Slawson

DRAFT MINUTES OF JANUARY 28, 2019
MEMBER SILVANO moved, seconded by MEMBER SHINN

  TO APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE JANUARY 28, 2019 EQUESTRIAN
  COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
Licensed horse trainer, Louise Koch, suggested that the equestrian committee revise the
Chandler Park horse arena rules to allow a third trainer in the arena if they are teaching
dressage. Chairman Huff stated that this request will be placed on the April 22 , 2019
Equestrian Committee agenda.

CALIFORNIA WATER SERVICE COMPANY WATER RELIABILITY PROJECT MONTHLY
UPDATE
Angie Gilbride from California Water Service Company distributed project update fact sheets
and highlighted the progress made thus far. She noted that the work on the Palomino Trail will
start near Rolling Hills Road and the go east towards Dapplegray School. Ms. Gilbride was
pleased to announce that no additional trail trees would be removed. CHAIRMAN HUFF
reported that the Montecillo Homeowners Association was pleased with the new asphalt in
their entryway.

HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF THANKED MS. GILBRIDE AND RECEIVED
AND FILED THIS AGENDA ITEM.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MARCH 25, 2019
 EQUESTRIAN FEES REVIEW
The Community Services Director highlighted all of the equestrian-related fees for the
committee. He noted that there were no fees for the horse show office or for the use of the
judge’s booth. MEMBER SILVANO felt that the horse show office and judges booth should
be included at no cost when renting an arena and Committee Members agreed.

MEMBER SILVANO moved, seconded by MEMBER BRTIS

  THAT NO EQUESTRIAN FEE CHANGES BE RECOMMENDED FOR FY 2019-20 OR
  CALENDAR YEAR 2020.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

HORSE CENSUS
Administrative Analyst Jessica Slawson reviewed a draft horse census. In order to get a
better response it was suggested by MEMBER KEMP to emphasize that the census is for the
City’s emergency preparedness measures.

MEMBER SHINN moved, seconded by MEMBER KEMP

  TO APPROVE THE HORSE CENUSUS AS REVISED.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG
There were no issues to report this month.

HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF RECEIVED AND FILED THE REPORT.

COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.  HORSE TRAINERS MEETING UPDATE

MEMBERS SIVLANO AND SHINN reported that the meeting with the City’s licensed horse
trainers went well. Trainers reported that they were appreciative of Mike Goldsmith’s,
Maintenance Superintendent’s NIXEL Alert messages concerning the horse arenas during the
past rainy months.

B.  EQUINE EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS SUBCOMMITTEE MEEING UPDATE

A horse trailering demonstration taught by Sean Martin has been scheduled for May 18, 2019
at Ernie Howlett Park from 10:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m. A draft list of proposed equine emergency
supplies to be placed in storage caches at the City’s equestrian parks was developed.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MARCH 25, 2019
 C.  MAYOR’S BREAKFAST RIDE

It was recommended that the status of the California Water Service Company project be
investigated prior to the ride as this may effect east side equestrians. Event flyers were taken
by several Committee Members to be distributed throughout the region.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
A.  PV PENINSULA WATER RELIABILITY PROJECT UPDATE – Monthly

B.  EQUINE EMERGENCY RESPONSE PLAN UPDATE – Monthly

C.  BROWN ACT REVIEW (To be determined by City Attorney)

D.  CHANDLER PARK ARENA RULES - 3RD TRAINER REQUEST (April 22, 2019)

ADJOURNMENT
MEMBER SILVANO moved, seconded by MEMBER KEMP

  TO ADJOURN THE EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF ADJOURNED THE MEETING.

The meeting adjourned at 7:58 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Andy Clark
Community Services Director

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES
MARCH 25, 2019
